text.tspan: Covers US 1.0.2. No profile edit exists in the code. All steps are Proposed.
The Edit control shows only on the
The action edits only the session user.
A user id from the client is not trusted.
Values are read from the database on each load. After sign out and sign in,
the profile shows the saved values (AT5). If the email is also the sign-in email,
a change must go through Supabase Auth (open question).

svg.text: Open own profile and select Edit
Change name, email, skills or focus areas
Check that name and email are not empty (AT3)
Block save and highlight the empty field (AT3)
Signed-in user id or no user
Show "You can edit only your own profile"
Check name and email again on server (AT3)
Update W26_profiles row of session user
Show error and keep the typed values
Show new values, skills and focus areas (AT4, AT6)
